A BILL ENTITLED 
 
AN ACT concerning 1 
 
Gaming – Sports Wagering Facilities – Request for Relocation 2 
 
FOR the purpose of authorizing certain sports wagering facility licensees to submit a 3 
written request to the State Lottery and Gaming Control Commission to relocate the 4 
sports wage ring facility , subject to certain limitations ; and generally relating to 5 
sports wagering facilities. 6 
 
BY adding to 7 
 Article – State Government 8 
Section 9–1E–07(j) 9

 SECTION 1. BE IT ENACTED BY THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY OF MARYLAND, 12 
That the Laws of Maryland read as follows: 13 
 
Article – State Government 14 
 
9–1E–07. 15 
 
 (J) (1) A SPORTS WAGERING FACILITY LICENSEE ISSUED A LICENSE 16 
UNDER § 9–1E–06(A)(2)(II) OF THIS SUBTITLE MAY SUBMIT A WRITTEN REQUEST TO 17 
THE COMMISSION TO RELOCATE A CLASS B SPORTS WAGERING FACILITY. 18 
 
  (2) THE COMMISSION MAY GRANT A REQUEST SUBMITTED UNDER 19 
PARAGRAPH (1) OF THIS SUBSECTION ONLY IF: 20 
 
   (I) THE SPORTS WAGERING  FACILITY LICENSEE WAS 21 
ORIGINALLY ISSUED A CLASS B SPORTS WAGERING FACILITY  LICENSE ON OR 22 
BEFORE SEPTEMBER 30, 2023; AND 23 
2 SENATE BILL 1000  
 
 
 
   (II) THE NEW LOCATION FOR THE SPORTS WAGERING FACILITY: 1 
 
    1. IS WITHIN THE SAME COUNTY; AND 2 
 
    2. COMPLIES WITH THE LOCATION REQUIREMENT S 3
